theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Energy (+0.59%) and Technology (+0.11%) led the market today, while Industrials (-1.60%) and Consumer Discretionary (-1.34%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged -0.53%, defensives -0.92%, and value/cyclicals -0.76% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 -0.48%, Dow -0.77%, Nasdaq -0.64% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps underperformed as well, with the Russell 2000 at -1.32%, hinting the move favored large, established balance sheets over smaller, more rate-sensitive companies. The VIX rose 4.64% to 16.46, pointing to a bit more caution creeping in beneath the surface. Gold added 0.55% to $4,444.90, crude oil was little changed at $97.02, and bitcoin slipped 0.57% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
